reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_lines_per_order,
       SUM(units) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM sales
WHERE channel = 'web'
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, COUNT(order_line_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_lines_per_order, SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_units_per_order FROM sales WHERE channel = 'web' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_lines_per_order, SUM(COALESCE(units, 0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_units_per_order FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND channel = 'web'
